answer.content: Assess the abstracts and introductions of preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 for frequency, co-occurrence, and semantic clustering of linguistic elements using natural language processing, focusing on non-mathematical, textual recurrence to detect possible thematic continuity without relying on citations or mathematical structures. Document patterns that suggest emergent thematic persistence in scientific discourse as a proxy for memory-like behavior in knowledge systems.
